planned.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Native landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG, ONE full-detail V2 LOCATION KEY for call_void, the Call in the October 25 rebuilt story. Establishing view of an endless perfectly still plane of BLACK WATER beneath a STARLESS, almost black navy sky, no land, no shore and no physical walls. Preserve the approved ink, cel colouring and drawn crispness. Reference 1 is Jaeha's approved front, reference 2 his approved turnaround and reference 3 his approved acting sheet: these lock the ONE tiny figure's design and full adult proportions. Reference 4 is an approved location key, used ONLY for the drawn vertical rift's edge treatment and environmental scale, not its red sky, architecture, cars or extra people. Reference 5 is the approved acting house-style anchor, for ink and colouring, not its characters or fortress room.

Around a SINGLE tiny lone Jaeha stand tall, narrow, VERTICAL RIFTS like open doors in space. Arrange them in a broad loose arc at different distances on the water plane, leaving dark open space between them. They are upright torn seams with very thin cold white-cyan #D8F4FF rims, not technological machines or solid door frames. One larger rift at picture-left clearly opens onto a BURNING PALE-STONE FORTRESS with a GREAT HANGING BRONZE BELL visible under a broad stone belfry arch; fire light glows inside that world. A second large rift at picture-right clearly shows a FIELD beneath a GREEN MOSSY FAR SIDE SKY, with one HUGE INDISTINCT SLEEPING SHAPE lying low in the grass. That sleeper is a distant landscape-sized dark mound with no exposed face, equipment or identifiable new character design. The other rifts show only shadow. The worlds are visible INSIDE their rift boundaries; the surrounding void stays black water and starless sky. Do not add the bell-armoured caller or any other person inside the rifts.

Thin, crisp Operator-cyan #3FE3F2 LINES run from the bases of the rifts across the surface to Jaeha, a sparse network converging at him. They are narrow luminous drawn threads with only local light, not broad laser beams or a giant UI diagram. Reflections of the rifts and cyan lines lie directly below their sources on the still black water, softened only slightly at a few natural tiny ripples at his boots. No ocean waves, foam, horizon shore, stars, planets, galaxies, mist blanket or lens flare.

ONE Jaeha, only about 70-85 pixels tall within this 1024-pixel image, well in the middle distance, looks toward the burning fortress rift in a natural slight three-quarter turn, weight on one leg, one gloved hand touching his vest pocket where the notebook remains stowed. Tiny but fully built: lean adult, 7.5-8 heads, long legs about half his height, no big chibi head, feet visibly supported by the water plane with a small dark reflection. His orange vest is the small warm human accent. His approved design is not enlarged into a foreground portrait. No duplicate figure, crowd, scale silhouette or extra summons.

Camera: wide establishing camera about 3 m above the water, gently looking down at the lone distant man and the rifts; consistent shared ground plane and horizon, nearer rifts larger and lower in frame, far rifts smaller with higher bases. The water takes the lower half of the composition, rifts and void fill the upper half. The figure remains much smaller than the rifts, which read as tall door-like openings. Strong readable silhouettes and calm dark negative space.

Named key light: the rifts' cold pale rims and thin Operator-cyan threads give restrained cool edge light; warm orange fire and subdued moss-green light remain localized to the two different rift interiors and their water reflections. The rest of the void stays deep navy #0B1530 / black, with crisp drawn edges, no CG gloss or all-over bloom. No text, labels, UI panels, numbers, caption, logos, watermark or signature. The small T on Jaeha's vest is the only permitted letter if large enough to read naturally; never add lettering to the environment.

Kang Jaeha: a lean 24-year-old Korean man, 178 cm; narrow oval face, defined cheekbones, straight nose, heavy upper eyelids with faint tired lines, dark brown eyes; messy near-black hair with navy-grey shine, a long fringe over his LEFT eye; a yellow pencil behind his RIGHT ear; a heather-grey hoodie under a frayed safety-orange trap-tester vest with two silver reflective stripes and a small white patch with a black block letter T on the right chest (this T is the only letter allowed anywhere in the image); a battered black notebook in the left chest pocket; black fingerless gloves; dark navy cargo work trousers; black work boots.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
